documentation.name: RETRIEVAL_DOC_ONLY_RESULTS.md
documentation.summary: DOC_ONLY retrieval test results for 146 questions from generated_testset.csv against 7 enterprise PDF/DOCX files (OCR scan + docx). All 4 key metrics PASS: Hit@5=1.0000 (>0.60), MRR@5=0.9825 (>0.45), Top1 Mean=0.5789 (>0.20), Fallback Rate=0.0000 (<0.20). Hit@1=0.9726, Hit@3=0.9863. Diagnostic: Vector score 0.4454, Text Rank 0.8905 (lexical dominates), Rerank keeps Hit@5 but drops Top1 score -0.0604. Latency: retrieve 2104ms (rerank 942ms = 45%). Root cause fixes: 1) Gold matcher separator '|' bug (Hit@5 0.36→1.00), 2) Reranker gate overwrote hybrid score (Fallback 0.57→0.00), 3) OCR lost Vietnamese diacritics (Tesseract tuned: vie, psm 6, oem 1, dpi 400), 4) Gold matcher OCR mismatch (keyword fallback). Corpus: 353 EVALRET chunks + 246 Labor Law chunks. Embedding: bkai-foundation-models/vietnamese-bi-encoder (768d, CUDA). Reranker: AITeamVN/Vietnamese_Reranker. Manual audit of 6 faithfulness=0 cases: 0/6 true hallucinations (all safe refusals or correct answers with OCR/table context mismatch). Judge false-negatives systematic on OCR/table Vietnamese. Recommendation: don't gate production on RAGAS+gpt-oss; use retrieval metrics (100% Hit@5) + deterministic checks + periodic manual spot-check. document:backend/src/main/java/com/minht.summary: Resignation service: core logic for resignation lifecycle (submit, approve/reject at each stage, withdraw, schedule exit interview, handover management, final settlement calculation, offboarding document tracking). Integrates with ResignationRequestRepository, UserProfileRepository, AssetAssignmentRepository (asset return), FileStorageService.
